question: Frozen return models: does training fit improvement survive chronological test years?
basis: User asks model progress; previous acceptance comparisons do not distinguish in-sample fit from transfer failure. Diagnostic only, no complexity selection.
scope: All return models saved R131; R130 repaired panel; original cohorts and maturity masks
metrics: Date equal MSE versus fixed training mean, skill=1-model_MSE/baseline_MSE; train and test separately; unknown test outcomes retained in counts
limitations: MSE skill does not establish ranking or tradability
cannot infer nonlinear signal absence from linear failure
